notes.title: Update 1.6: User Usability Enhancement Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27307063/c662a21cb9e066744cd2a6a7773800182f57cbf4.jpg[/img]

 - Added a mouse lock during gameplay to constrict the mouse inside the game window during windowed gameplay. *
 - Added statements to confirmations on menus.
 - Added more menu sounds.
 - Modified menus. Left and right work as they visually should rather than working similar to up and down. Escape or B button on the controller now triggers back button.
 - Fixed the automatic pause when the window is out of focus.
 - Fixed a background shimmer effect when using lower resolutions.
 - Fixed cloud arrangement for Night Pig.
 - Fixed excessive bump sound effect when two pigs bump into one another.
 - Fixed an issue with the countdown timer.
 - Modified purple parrots to gradually turn blue after they've moved up.

* To go into more detail about the mouse lock in the windowed gameplay. If the game is paused or in a menu, you have full control of the mouse again, inside or outside of the game to click and drag the window or do whatever. It is still possible to accidentally click outside the window if you really try, but that's why the auto pause is working if the window ever loses focus while playing. 

A shout out and thank you to the person that reported the issue.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1 Mouse + Keyboard is Back
notes.notes:
- Added a switch in the settings to toggle between mouse movement + mouse jump and keyboard movement + mouse jump

Update 1.3.2
 - Fixed a variable that was off when it should have been on.

Yes its just that one thing. For anyone that uses touch screen, keyboard or controller exclusively, you will be unaffected.

While you're here... I should talk about the struggles and challenges getting this update out to you.

Once upon a time someone said he wanted to use mouse only controls while he takes a drink of something. You could always pause the game, but when you're in the zone you need to stay there and have your thirst quenched. With the intensity of Balloon Popping Pigs, people sweat profusely. This is all embellishment, I hear that's the key to good storytelling.

I tried my best to have precise only controls for both jumping and movement. You had to push your mouse a bit to ensure that you would move intentional.

Well there are the traditionalists that remember the good ole days when it was a mouse to jump and a keyboard to move. I also neglected the hardcore players who always wear a hydration helmet so they never have to take their hands off the controls. They wanted the precise - ivity of the keyboard and mouse.

Then like trying to decide cake or ice cream someone said "why not have both?"

In an attempt to make Balloon Popping Pigs accessible to everyone on all sorts of devices, this old control scheme was brought back into the furious action! Prepare to have your mind blown as with the flip of a switch in the settings you can go from one to the other without the struggle of having to update confusing .ini files.

Armed with my forging hammer I hopped back into the game smithery and restored the ancient control scheme to its former glory. Days of work flew by in minutes using the mighty hammer that was given to me by my ailing grandfather when he said... let the players play how they want!

The challenge was to update the settings menu as its getting full of options. Buttons for touch screen support, removing data, viewing credits and many others are all there. The game now [b]features[/b] an overwhelming 42 icons sealed within its mighty 40 MB file.

With the update done, I quickly trudged up the mountaintop shrine to present the game to the mighty Steam where it was then bolted away from my grasp by lightning up into a cloud. It was gone and off to the world now where that massive cloud would rain down the goodness of another Balloon Popping Pigs update into your PCs.

The work was over once more... but for how long? Will there be more updates? How can more settings fit into a menu? When will there be new secret characters? Why have I written this long update? Where will you be when you next play Balloon Popping Pigs?

Only the future will be able to answer all these questions.

Have a great day, night or morning. Thanks for reading and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 1.3 The Players Asked for It
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TEs0rv3.jpg[/img]

Here are the short details: 
 - Added a new background, crumble canyon.
 - Added quick presses move character selects faster than holding down.
 - Added the ability to back out of pick a pig and return to the title screen.
 - Added purple parrot to replace the top parrots. Purple parrots will fly up to become top parrots. If you are quick enough you can pop their balloon.
 - Added a new pick a pig select screen to replace the old one. This is better for two players and readability.
 - Modified pig unlocks from 75 coins to 50 coins. New players will now start with 40 coins rather than 50 coins.
 - Modified player balloons to shift when they are popped so balloons on the far side will become centered.
 - Modified mouse / touch select for pick a pig. You now select the pig before you confirm it with a second click.
 - Modified point text popup colors to aqua and lime when leveling up and when being given double points from consecutive balloon pops without jumping.
 - Fixed daily and weekly leaderboards.

Two of the biggest issues people have had with the game have always been, why can't I get to the top parrot, it takes too many coins to unlock a pig. The top parrot was always there to be so there was no safe part of the screen. If you could pop every balloon, why would you ever come down? This update lets you get those pesky purple parrots before they turn into top parrots. 

There have always been many ways to get coins. The first is to collect them as they spawn faster and faster from every fifteen seconds down to five. The other way is getting a game over will give you a coin for every 250 points. The cost of ungrounding new pigs has gone down from 75 to 50.

Thanks as always to everyone for their feedback.

notes.title: Pre-Release Update 9: 2 Player Competitive
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cL13LP6.gif[/img]

Two player has been split into 3 modes at least for the moment. Cooperative that has both players on the full screen and competitive that has one player confined to their own half of the screen. 

Because each player has only one half of the screen, equal amounts of balloons spawn on each side at the same place. It seems only fair they be exact. So for every right parrot there is a left parrot. if they float out of one half of the screen into the next, then the other player can pop that balloon. The level up balloon bonuses are also equal on each side.

At the moment there are no double balloons and there is only one star balloon in the center that appears as usual. It should be a mad dash to get to that all important balloon.

With competitive mode there is survival and timed. Times lasts for 3 minutes and whomever scores the most points wins. If one player plummets they lose points, but respawn. 3 minutes might be too short of a time span. Survival is just that you keep going until both players have plummet.

Here are other things for the update:

 - Added a second score statement for two player mode after both pigs are defeated.
 - Added cooperative and competitive 2 player modes rather than an ambiguous 2 player mode.
 - Added a forgiving 3 seconds of invulnerability for your balloons when one is popped.
 - Fixed the version text to be more consistent from computer to computer.
 - Fixed an issue where one player using the same controller for two players without getting stuck in the selection screen.
 - Fixed the new logo's collision.
 - Modified timer to turn red during the last 5 seconds.

notes.title: Pre-Release Update 3: Now on the Steam, Catch the Cake
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/8LJHW9w.gif[/img]

[b]Pre-Release Update 3: Now on the Steam, Catch the Cake[/b]

 - Added "Catch the Cake" as a bonus when you pop a star balloon with all three of your balloons in tact. cake will drop from the sky and grant you points. This will give you a break from being attacked.
 - Added monthly and weekly leaderboards rather than only best and daily.
 - Added Steam cards, badges, emoticons and wallpapers are now live for all the testers. There are a few more emoticons that need to be approved.
 - Added Steam cloud support that will be good for people who play on multiple computers or if you ever migrate over to a new computer.
 - Modified enemy spawning to be once per second to prevent clusters of enemies in the later levels from becoming a wall.
 - Modified enemy spawning when your own balloons are popped, enemies will spawn less for a moment. This is only noticeable in higher levels.

Here are the past updates between Greenlight and now:

[b]Pre-Release Update 2: Release Enhancements[/b]

- Added damage effects when enemies fall.
- Added controller rumble functionality (quite a long time ago)
- Added settings for shake screen and controller rumble.
- Added text hints to menu items. Menu items have always been icons on buttons.
- Added leaderboard and daily leaderboard support.
- Added damage effects to enemies as they fall.
- Added a background to the stats text in the background.
- Modified windowed mode to be 3x larger.
- Fixed an inconsistent glitch that lets you hide your balloons above the screen.
- Fixed cheat console's input box from not showing up when there was no text.
- Modified a lot of fonts to look better.
- Modified cheat console to open and close with a different set of keys.
- Fixed using escape key from pick a pig before the game starts.

[b]Pre-Release Update 1: The Waiting Room Update[/b]

- Modified menu controls to move in less time and move when directly pressed such as press right, right rather than hold right.
- Added multiple controller support for the menus rather than only gameplay.
- Added ability to pause with controllers and keyboards rather than touch screen.
- Added the ability to pause automatically if the window has lost focus.
- Added controller rumble functionality. The game also detects which controller the player is using or if the player is using a controller.
- Modified the frog enemy to appear at level 5 and up.
- Fixed glitch with the frog where if you die the frog would never appear again until you exit the game.
- Modified the ceiling bump noise to happen once until you lower out of the screen top area.
- Modified bounce mechanic so you can only bounce on a balloon if you're moving downward. It may change back by the time the game is released.
- Fixed a crash related to taking a screenshot.

Chances are there were a lot more updates before these.
